cards.stem: How heavy was the 1901 aircraft itself expected to be without a pilot
cards.quote: The 1901 aircraft had been designed to lift itself (100 pounds)
cards.hint: Focus on the design weight for the aircraft alone

cards.stem: How was lift found to change when speed increases
cards.quote: it had been determined that lift depends on the square of the velocity and varies linearly with the surface area of the object.
cards.hint: Consider how lift was described relative to speed

cards.stem: What pressure term does the current lift formula rely on
cards.quote: The modern equation uses the dynamic pressure of the moving air for the pressure dependence, while this equation uses the Smeaton coefficient.
cards.hint: Compare old and new formulations of pressure effect
